title: SBP
publishedHtml:
CloudPayments offers a one-click payment method via the SBP (Faster Payments System). The buyer can select any bank to make the payment through the Faster Payments System.

Get a payment link

Description

Method for getting the payment link to redirect the customer to the bank’s mobile app. The response returns the QrUrl parameter containing the redirect URL.

To process the payment, redirect the customer to the received URL.

Endpoint

https://api.cloudpayments.ru/payments/qr/sbp/link

Request parameters

Parameter

Format

Required

Description

PublicId

string

Yes

Website ID, can be found in the dashboard

Amount

decimal

Yes

Payment amount in rubles. Use a dot as the decimal separator. Number of decimal places: 2

Currency

string

Yes

Currency: RUB (see the reference)

Description

string

No

Payment description (free-form)

AccountId

string

No

User ID, required to create a subscription and obtain a token

Email

string

No

Payer email for receiving payment confirmation

JsonData

JSON

No

Any other data associated with the transaction, including instructions for creating a subscription or generating an online receipt, must be wrapped in the cloudpayments object. We have reserved the names of the following parameters and their values are displayed in the transaction register downloaded from the dashboard: name, firstName, middleName, lastName, nick, phone, address, comment, birthDate

InvoiceId

string

No

Invoice number/ID. Passed in the Check notification and can be used to validate the order number

Scheme

enum string

Yes

Payment processing method (see Transaction types). Possible meanings: charge (single-stage payment)

SuccessRedirectUrl

string

No

Customer redirect URL after a successful payment. Once the payment is processed, the customer will be redirected from the bank's mobile app to the specified URL. The value must not exceed 1024 characters, must be ASCII-encoded, and must comply with the RFC 3986 specification format

IpAddress

string

No

Payer IP address

Os

string

No

Payer's device operating system. Example values: Android, iOS, Windows

Webview

bool

No

Indicator of whether the browser is running in WebView mode. Possible values: true for payments using webview, false for payments without webview

Device

string

No

Payer's device type flag. Possible values: MobileApp for payments initiated from a mobile app; DesktopWeb for payments initiated from a desktop browser; Mobile for payments initiated from a mobile browser

Browser

string

No

Customer's browser name derived from the browser's User-Agent string. Example values: Chrome, Firefox, MIUI Browser, Opera

TtlMinutes

int

No

Time window during which the payment via QR code or payment link remains available. Minimum allowable value: 1. The maximum allowable value: 129 600 (90 days). If this parameter is omitted, the payment can be completed within 72 hours

SaveCard

bool

No

Indicator of whether to save the card to link the account within the National Payment Card System for subsequent charges

IsTest

bool

No

Test mode flag

The server returns a JSON response with the following three properties:

  • Success: request result

  • Message: error description

  • Model: additional information

Response examples:

  1. Malformed request:

    • Success: false

    • Message: error description

  2. Transaction declined:

    • Success: false

    • Model: transaction information and an error code

  3. Transaction accepted:

    • Success: true

    • Model: transaction information

Notice: The request result (the Success field) does not reflect the transaction status; it only indicates the success or failure of the API request. The transaction status is reflected in the additional Status field, and can also be obtained via received notifications. For the interpretation of transaction statuses, see reference. _SBP

Request example

javascript
{
    "PublicId": "test_api_00000000000000000000002",
    "Amount": 1000,
    "Currency": "RUB",
    "Description": "Payment by SBP",
    "AccountId": "email@email.com",
    "Email": "email@email.com",
    "InvoiceId": "order_no4009",
    "Scheme": "charge",
    "SuccessRedirectUrl": "https://cp.ru",
    "SaveCard": false
}

Response example

javascript
{
    "Model": {
        "QrUrl": "{URL-address}",
        "QrImage": null,
        "TransactionId": 11122233344,
        "MerchantOrderId": "12345",
        "ProviderQrId": "BB1S004HCK9PFD0F996RJI3208UE",
        "Amount": 10,
        "Message": "Created",
        "IsTest": false
    },
    "Success": true,
    "Message": null
}

Get a QR code for payment

Description

Method for getting the QR code to show the customer in the browser. The response returns the QrImage parameter containing the QR code in imagePNG format for customer display. The string value is Base64-encoded.

To process the payment, redirect the customer to the received URL. Customers can complete a payment an unlimited number of times using a single SBP QR code.

Endpoint

https://api.cloudpayments.ru/payments/qr/sbp/image

Request parameters

See SBP, Get a payment link

Request example

See SBP, Get a payment link

Response example

javascript
{
    "Model": {
        "QrUrl": null,
        "QrImage": "{string}",
        "TransactionId": 11122233344,
        "MerchantOrderId": "12345",
        "ProviderQrId": "BB1S004HCK9PFD0F996RJI3208UE",
        "Amount": 10,
        "Message": "Created",
        "IsTest": false
    },
    "Success": true,
    "Message": null
}


List of SBP participants

Description

Method returns the list of Faster Payments System (SBP) participants based on the customer's platform. The data source is the SBP widget API.

Endpoint

https://api.cloudpayments.ru/sbp/v2/banks/info

Request parameters

Parameter

Type

Required

Description

AccountId

string

No

User account ID

IsRenewSubscription

bool

No

Subscription update flag

JsonData

string

No

Additional data in JSON format

Platform

string

No

Customer's platform (desktop, iOS, Android)

PublicTerminalId

string

Yes

Public ID of the terminal

SaveCard

bool

No

Indicator of whether to save the card

Token

string

No

Card token to be saved

Request example

javascript
{
  "PublicTerminalId": "pk_1234567890abcdef",
  "Platform": "ios"
}

Response parameters

Parameter

Type

Description

Success

bool

Request success flag

Message

string

Error description in case of failure (null if successful)

Model

list<SbpMemberDto>

List of SBP participant data

Model.Source

string

Data source

Model.Version

string

Response specification version

Model.Members

list<SbpMemberDataDto>

List of SBP participants

Model.Members.Id

string

Unique ID of SBP participant

Model.Members.Name

string

Full name of the bank or SBP participant

Model.Members.Logo

string

URL of the bank logo

Model.Members.Url

string

Redirect URL to the bank's mobile app or web-banking portal

Response example

javascript
{
  "Success": true,
  "Message": null,
  "Model": [
    {
      "Source": "widget",
      "Version": "2.0",
      "Members": [
        {
          "id": "100000000111",
          "logo": "https://qr.nspk.ru/proxyapp/logo/bank100000000111.png",
          "name": "Sberbank",
          "url": "bank100000000111://qr.nspk.ru/{QRC_ID}{QUERY_STRING}"
        },
        {
          "id": "100000000004",
          "logo": "https://qr.nspk.ru/proxyapp/logo/bank100000000004.png",
          "name": "T-Bank",
          "url": "https://www.tinkoff.ru/mybank/payments/qr-pay/{QRC_ID}{QUERY_STRING}"
        },
        {
          "id": "100000000005",
          "logo": "https://qr.nspk.ru/proxyapp/logo/bank100000000005.png",
          "name": "VTB Bank",
          "url": "https://online.vtb.ru/i/paymentSbp/{QRC_ID}{QUERY_STRING}"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Refund

The refund method for SBP operations is identical to the refund method used for online acquiring operations. See API, Refund.

SBP refunds operate asynchronously. The final SBP refund status ("Completed" or "Declined") can be obtained via a Refund notification after the refund transaction has been created, rather than within the immediate response to the refund request itself.

Notifications

Notifications for SBP operations are identical to notifications for internet acquiring operations. See Notifications.

The parameter responsible for the operation type within the notification is PaymentMethod (which is set to Sbp for SBP transactions).

If Check notifications are enabled, a Check request will be sent prior to generating the QR code or payment link to validate the data accuracy.

Generate direct links and the bank list

A direct link redirects the payer to a specific bank's mobile app when clicked.

The bank list can be retrieved from the array of elements returned in the response to the request POST: /sbp/v2/banks/info in the Model.Members parameter.

CloudPayments utilizes the participant list retrieved from the SBP widget API.

SBP integration requirements

Must remain unchanged:

  1. Bank order: the original sequence of banks must not be altered (the original order is maintained by CloudPayments)

  2. Names and logos

  3. URLs used to redirect customers to banking applications

Required:

  1. Bank search feature (must be preserved)

  2. Data caching (enforced on the CloudPayments side):

    • Use only data that is no more than 24 hours old

    • In the event of a request failure, use the latest available working data

Allowed customization:

  • Display the top 3 banks previously selected by the customer

Specifications of SBP bank list display

List element ordering

  1. Elements on the bank selection page must be arranged strictly in the order returned in the response to the POST /sbp/v2/banks/info request.

  2. Exception:

    • A maximum of 3 previously selected banks may be displayed at the top of the list.

    • The remaining banks must follow in their original sequence, excluding those already moved to the top.

Bank logo

The bank logo must be retrieved from the response to the POST /sbp/v2/banks/info request, using the Model.Members.logo parameter.

Bank name

The bank name must be retrieved from the response to the POST /sbp/v2/banks/info request, using the Model.Members.Name parameter.

Link to the bank app

To generate a direct link that redirects the customer to a specific bank's mobile application, use the following steps:

  1. Retrieve the payment link from the response to the POST /payments/qr/sbp/link request, using the Model.QrUrl parameter.

  2. Retrieve the bank link template from the response to the POST /sbp/v2/banks/info request, using the Model.Members.url parameter.

  3. Process the link template:

    • Remove the trailing path element: {QRC_ID}{QUERY_STRING}.

  4. Generate the final link:

    • Concatenate the remaining part of the template with the path and query parameters extracted from the payment link.

URL transformation example

  1. Payment link: https://qr.nspk.ru/AD1000XXXXX1000?type=02&bank=100000000004&sum=1299900&cur=RUB&crc=8DA8

  2. Link template: https://online.vtb.ru/i/paymentSbp/{QRC_ID}{QUERY_STRING}

  3. Resulting link: https://online.vtb.ru/i/paymentSbp/AD1000XXXXX1000?type=02&bank=100000000004&sum=1299900&cur=RUB&crc=8DA8
